goal: Prefer under-linking over over-deduplication so one real commercial opportunity is never silently swallowed by a same-name record.

canonical_identity_priority.rule: When an official project number exists, records carrying the exact same project number may share one canonical project identity.
For source-native records such as CCGP procurement-intent projId, use the exact native record id to keep same-title records distinct.
If no official project number/native record id exists, the source record URL is the identity boundary. Buyer/title similarity must not merge records.

cross_stage_bridge_policy.minimum_principle: A candidate is only a review hint. Canonical merge remains prohibited until deterministic public bridge evidence is implemented and validated.
cross_stage_bridge_policy.llm_role: An LLM may suggest additional link candidates but may never perform the canonical merge without deterministic evidence.
